latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Text to Video Duration skill.
- Instantly convert text scripts into timed AI-generated videos (e.g., "turn this into a 30-second video with visuals and background music").
- Supports uploads of TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT files up to 500MB.
- No complex setup: free 100-credit trial available with anonymous token workflow.
- Cloud rendering delivers MP4s (and other formats) in 30–90 seconds, with timeline/session management for iterative edits.
- Easy export, file upload, credit check, and session status commands built-in.
